text: Varying the Einstein-Hilbert action S = c⁴/(16πG) ∫ R√−g d⁴x with respect to the metric yields the ___ field equations.
explanation: The book shows that requiring δS/δg^{μν} = 0 for the Einstein-Hilbert action gives R_{μν} − ½ g_{μν} R + Λ g_{μν} = 0, i.e. Einstein's field equations; including S_matter gives G_{μν} + Λ g_{μν} = (8πG/c⁴) T_{μν}. This is Hilbert's 1915 variational derivation.
